 Serbia vs Germany: kick-off time
 UEFA Nations League A - Game Week 5 13 Nov 2026 - 13:45 Stadion Rajko Mitic Germany face Serbia at the Rajko Mitić Stadium in Belgrade in UEFA Nations League A, Group 2. Jürgen Klopp's side are looking to close the gap at the top of the table.
 Four defeats in their first four group matches, including two against Germany and the Netherlands, have left Serbia bottom of the group. Head coach Veljko Paunović's side are under considerable pressure.
 Klopp takes Germany to Belgrade with mixed feelings. He has named a 24-man squad for the matches against Serbia and the Netherlands, with a focus on attacking performances. Niclas Füllkrug leads the Bundesliga goalscoring charts and returns to the national team after more than a year away.
 In goal, Klopp is firmly backing Marc-André ter Stegen, who has returned to his former level after his serious injury at FC Ajax. Bayern Munich trio Joshua Kimmich, Aleksandar Pavlović and Tom Bischof are expected to drive Germany's build-up play from midfield.
 Germany won the first meeting in Munich comfortably, 2-0. They now aim to take the next step towards the quarter-finals in Belgrade and close the gap on group leaders the Netherlands.
 Find the broadcast, kick-off and line-up information below.
 Serbia and Germany: recent results
 Serbia have lost their five most recent competitive matches and are in the poorest form in the group. Their latest defeat came on 4 October 2026, when they lost 2-1 to the Netherlands. Before that, Serbia also lost 2-0 to Germany and 5-1 to Mexico in a friendly. Across those five matches, they scored only five goals and conceded twelve.
 Germany have a more balanced record heading to Belgrade: one win, two draws and two defeats in their last five matches. They drew 0-0 with Greece on 4 October, having beaten Serbia 2-0 in the first meeting and drawn 1-1 with the Netherlands. Germany scored four times and conceded two goals across those five matches.
